text:
Nina - Growth: Quick ask  create a one-page quick reference for enterprise buyers comparing security posture, SLA, and deployment time for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Needs to be snappy for webinar handout.

Ethan - PMM: Include 1-line summaries, a tiny compliance matrix, inbound routing mapping, and a short benchmark line with placeholders for numbers. SDRs want HubSpot tags and a 2-line qualification script.

Ravi - Solutions: Add a "Key decision checklist" (3 bullets per mode). Eg Hosted: no infra changes, fast start; Dedicated: reserved GPUs, SLA; Private: on-prem, full control.

Maya - Sales: For inbound routing use tags: enterprise:security, enterprise:pilot, enterprise:scale. Routing plays: security -> AE+Solutions -> security briefing; pilot -> SDR->Solutions->trial; scale -> AE+Platform lead.

Ibrahim - Product: Benchmark placeholder: "95th-pctl latency (1k token gen): Hosted ~140ms | Dedicated ~90ms | Private 90-180ms. Cost estimate per 1M tokens: Hosted $A | Dedicated $B (amortized) | Private: varies." Add method note: "internal harness; quantization/batching affect values".

LegalBot: Reminder  include legal review 48-72h before publish for SLA claims.

Nina - Growth: I'll assemble the PDF and social snippets. Can someone confirm 'time to demo' again?

Ravi - Solutions: Time to demo: Hosted immediate, Dedicated trial 3-10 days, Private 4-8 weeks. Also include "customer-managed keys supported" and "audit logs available on Dedicated/Private".

Maya - Sales: SDR script: "Thanks for reaching out! Quick Q: is this for a regulated workload? If yes, we'll schedule a security briefing with Solutions. If not, we can set a Dedicated trial in ~3 days."

Ethan - PMM: I'll drop the first draft copy into Notion and tag the channel. Let's aim to send to legal by Tuesday.

Nina - Growth: Thanks everyone; will post the draft and the two ready-to-copy social posts in the doc.

(threads end)
